setting.sl: Vroče poletno popoldne. Na vrtu si, soseda pa se nasloni na plot in malo poklepeta o vremenu, vrtu in ribezu (Ribisel). Najprej te vika, potem pa ti ponudi tikanje.
setting.en: A hot summer afternoon. You are in the garden, and the neighbour leans on the fence for a chat about the weather, the garden and her redcurrants (Ribisel). She says Sie at first, then offers to say du.
setting.it: Un caldo pomeriggio d'estate. Sei in giardino e la vicina si appoggia allo steccato per fare due chiacchiere sul tempo, sull'orto e sui suoi ribes (Ribisel). All'inizio ti dà del Lei, poi ti propone di darvi del tu.

role: Frau Moser, Herta, the retired neighbour. Kind and curious, loves her garden, offers {learner} a bowl of redcurrants. Austrian German: Ribisel, Paradeiser, gell? Says Sie to {learner} at first; after a few lines she offers du ("Ich bin die Herta. Sagen wir du?") and says du from then on.
